title: Clevis Support Bracket (drawing CSB-100-01, Rev A)
general_tolerance_note: ISO 2768-1 medium; 1st angle projection; all dimensions in mm; break all sharp edges 0.5×45° unless otherwise specified; machined surfaces Ra 1.6 µm or better; remove burrs and sharp edges; finish: zinc plated ISO 4042

inner span dimension across the fork (front view / section A-A)
slot width between the fork prongs
2×45 chamfer on the fork prong tops
pin bore diameter, ISO tolerance class H7, THRU
typical fillet radius at the rib transitions (R6 TYP.)
upper-section height of the fork (front / side view)
mid-height dimension of the bracket body
overall height of the bracket
base plate thickness
base step / chamfer height
base mounting-hole spacing chain dimension (appears twice)
base edge-margin chain dimension (appears twice)

2 mounting holes Ø13.5 THRU
counterbore diameter for the Ø13.5 mounting holes
counterbore depth for the Ø13.5 mounting holes

lug-head outer radius in the side view
typical base corner radius (R10 TYP.)
base length in the side view
base plate width

counterbore diameter in detail B (2:1)
counterbore depth in detail B (2:1)
1×45 chamfer in detail B (2:1)

parallelism 0.05 to datum A (geometric tolerances table)
true position 0.05 to datums A|B|C (geometric tolerances table)
machined-surface roughness Ra 1.6 µm or better (notes)

scoring.match_rule: An LLM-extracted dimension matches a GT entry if (a) kind matches OR is a compatible alias, (b) numerical value within ±0.05 (mm precision), (c) tolerances within ±0.05 if specified. Compound counterbore annotations are split into hole + counterbore-diameter + counterbore-depth entries; the model gets credit for each independently. A feature dimensioned in more than one view (e.g. Ø16 H7 in the front view and section A-A) is counted once. ISO tolerance classes (H7) and 'TYP.' notes are recorded in 'as_drawn' but are not required for a numerical match.
scoring.passing_threshold: Strong = recall and precision >= 0.85; Pass = both >= 0.70.
